lines.t: Verse 1
I’ve been walking with my eyes half closed
Tracing lines I already know;
I said I’d learn, said I was done,
But it seemed I kept tryin’ to run.
I felt broken inside,
But still I rebelled.
Said I didn’t need You,
For oh so long,
But then I realized I was so wrong.
I hear Your name in the quiet ache
Whenever I choose my own way.
Pre-Chorus
You looked at me
And You corrected my wrong.
You don’t raise Your voice to break my heart,
You do it cause of the love
You had from the start.
Chorus
If You pull me close, as Your correcting me,
I know it’s because of love.
You don’t turn Your face when I fall apart,
You correct me like You’re guarding my heart.
I’ve sinned, I’ve run, I’ve crossed the line,
But You still call me “Mine”.
If Your hand is heavy, I understand
You only discipline who You can’t let go of,
Now I see. You still love me.
Verse 2
I’ve said “sorry” a thousand times,
But forgiveness still feels undeserved.
I brace myself for the silence
But You’re closer than I thought I deserved.
I didn’t know You disciplined
Out of love.
But You don’t let me go,
Even when I do wrong.
You help raise my weak voice
Into song.
Bridge
So I won’t hide when You say my name
Even if it breaks me open.
I’d rather feel the truth
Than stay frozen.
Chorus
If You pull me close, as Your correcting me,
I know it’s because of love.
You don’t turn Your face when I fall apart,
You correct me like You’re guarding my heart.
I’ve sinned, I’ve run, I’ve crossed the line,
But You still call me “Mine”.
If Your hand is heavy, I understand
You only discipline who You can’t let go of,
Now I see. You still love me.
Final Chorus
If You pull me close, as Your correcting me,
I trust Your love more than my fear.
You don’t walk away when I think I’m hard to love,
You stay, You stay right here.
If You pull me close, as Your correcting me,
I trust Your love more than my fear.
You don’t walk away when I think I’m hard to love,
You stay, You stay right here.
I’ve sinned, I’ve run, I’ve crossed the line,
But You still say I’m Yours.
If You’re correcting me, I understand,
It’s proof I’m not forgotten.
You still love me —
Yeah, You still love me
Outro
Now I know, Lord.
Now I know, Lord.
You correct and discipline
Those You love.
